scope:
HAL20 consolidated candidates with opt-in exact-artifact guard. No private dependencies published.
Engine/controller boundaries are modeled; not gameplay Windows certification.

profiles.name: tw-object-h0-d0-before-m300

checks.name: native-MainRunDuel-admission-fence
checks.details: Actual current Main_RunDuel body; engine beyond first entry is not executed.

checks.name: admission-matches-request
checks.details: Unsafe requested order must not enter controller.

checks.name: first-owner-action-boundary
checks.details: Real planner, producer, materializer and available native controller; adversarial faults are explicit.

checks.name: real-owner-BLOCKED-reproduced
checks.details: Bounded real snapshot divergences, no pending injection.

checks.name: unscoped-InitScene-does-not-invalidate-owner
checks.details: Even init-like globals do not replace the delegated Main_RunDuel call scope. No pending clear or physical write.

checks.name: scene-settings-shuffle-are-not-new-duel-proof
checks.details: Existing player-deck shuffle delegates; scene/settings alone do not authorize recovery.

checks.name: end-controller-does-not-recover-owner
checks.details: Actual Main cases1/2 over explicit fixture end flag, IO/frontend services modeled. End alone never revives an action.

checks.name: actual-Main-entry-no-ModulesReset
checks.details: Actual Main_RunDuel case1 and owner callbacks; InitScene IO/frontend/renderer remain modeled.

checks.name: new-duel-invalidates-RD-context
checks.details: Owner invalidates its own references before planning; serial never reset; no recover or physical rollback.

checks.name: old-companion-ticket-refused
checks.details: Old generation/connection/client/action cannot cross the proven boundary.

checks.name: old-TW-callbacks-refused
checks.details: TW owns its own closure/context; RD never clears its internals.

checks.name: OBSERVE-new-refusal-is-fresh-action
checks.details: Owner was reset at the boundary, then the unchanged OBSERVE workload creates new bounded conflicts. No priority decision is promoted.
